obligations.text:
SCHEDULE 17
Review of processing of personal data for the purposes of journalism
Section 178
Interpretation
1
In this Schedule—
“relevant period” means—
...
the period of 12 months beginning when the Commission starts a ... review under section 178;
“the relevant review”, in relation to a relevant period, means the review under section 178 which the Commission must produce a report about by the end of that period.

(2)
If the information notice—
(a)
states that, in the Commission's opinion, the information or documents are required for the purposes of the relevant review, and
(b)
gives the Commission's reasons for reaching that opinion,
subsections (5) and (6) of section 142 do not apply but the notice must not require the information or documents to be provided before the end of the period of 24 hours beginning when the notice is given.

(2)
If the assessment notice—
(a)
states that, in the Commission's opinion, it is necessary for the controller or processor to comply with a requirement in the notice for the purposes of the relevant review, and
(b)
gives the Commission's reasons for reaching that opinion,
subsections (6) and (7) of section 146 do not apply but the notice must not require the controller or processor to comply with the requirement before the end of the period of 7 days beginning when the notice is given.

(2)
If the interview notice—
(a)
states that, in the Commission's opinion, it is necessary for the individual to comply with a requirement in the notice for the purposes of the relevant review, and
(b)
gives the Commission's reasons for reaching that opinion,
subsections (6) and (7) of section 148A do not apply but the notice must not require the individual to comply with the requirement before the end of the period of 24 hours beginning when the notice is given.
